headline: Assam Teacher Wins National Award for Turning Students Into Educators
meta_description: An Assam educator received India's National Teachers' Award for an innovative program empowering students to teach literacy and digital skills to their mothers.
summary_short: A teacher in Assam has won India's National Teachers' Award for a creative initiative that transforms students into instructors for their own mothers, many of whom never…
body:
A teacher in Assam has won India's National Teachers' Award for turning his own students into teachers for their mothers—many of whom never learned to read or use digital payments.

The innovative "Each One Teach" program flips the traditional classroom model, placing young learners in the role of educators. By teaching digital skills and literacy to their mothers, students reinforce their own knowledge while addressing a critical gap in their families and communities. The approach tackles two challenges at once: strengthening student engagement through meaningful teaching, and expanding access to essential skills among women who missed formal schooling opportunities.

This recognition from India's educational establishment validates an unconventional path to breaking cycles of educational inequality. Rather than waiting for top-down solutions, the program demonstrates how a single teacher's vision can mobilize the most accessible resource—the children themselves—to create lasting change within their own households.
